name: M3_PMS100MI_LstMaterials
description: List all material lines connected to a specific released manufacturing order in a given facility and product.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item on the order.

inputParameters.name: SINV
inputParameters.description: Indicator to select only material lines with inventory accounting method equal to one.

inputParameters.name: DBYP
inputParameters.description: Indicator to exclude by-product material lines from the selection.

inputParameters.name: SALT
inputParameters.description: Indicator to include alternative material lines in the selection.

inputParameters.name: DFRM
inputParameters.description: Indicator to exclude material lines that have already been fully reported as finished.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number where the manufacturing order is registered.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order is registered.

outputParameters.name: PRNO
outputParameters.description: Product number for the manufactured item on the order.

outputParameters.name: MFNO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number.

outputParameters.name: MSEQ
outputParameters.description: Sequence number identifying this material line within the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: MTNO
outputParameters.description: Component number used on this material line.

outputParameters.name: ITDS
outputParameters.description: Description of the component on this material line.

outputParameters.name: OPNO
outputParameters.description: Operation number where the component is first used.

outputParameters.name: REQT
outputParameters.description: Reserved quantity for this component on the material line.

outputParameters.name: RDAT
outputParameters.description: Planned reservation date when the component is to be issued.

outputParameters.name: CNQT
outputParameters.description: Required quantity of the component on this material line.

outputParameters.name: BYPR
outputParameters.description: By/co-product code indicating whether the component is a normal item, by-product, co-product, or main product.

outputParameters.name: PUIT
outputParameters.description: Acquisition code defining how the component requirement is supplied, such as manufacturing or purchasing.

outputParameters.name: RTYP
outputParameters.description: Record type indicating how this material line is identified for item and supplier combinations.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when this material line was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHNO
outputParameters.description: Change number associated with the latest update of this material line.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User ID who last changed this material line.

outputParameters.name: SPMO
outputParameters.description: Manufacturing order number that supplies this component, if the component is produced by another order.

outputParameters.name: NWST
outputParameters.description: Network status of the material line in the advanced planning or scheduling network.

outputParameters.name: SATD
outputParameters.description: Safety time in days applied to this material requirement before the actual need date.

outputParameters.name: ALQT
outputParameters.description: Allocated quantity of the component expressed in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: RNQT
outputParameters.description: Remaining quantity to be allocated for this component in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: TRQT
outputParameters.description: Quantity involved in the latest transaction for this material line in the basic unit of measure.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse from which the component is issued.

outputParameters.name: PWHL
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the manufactured product on the order is stocked.

outputParameters.name: SPDO
outputParameters.description: Supplying distribution order number linked to this material line, if applicable.

outputParameters.name: SPDL
outputParameters.description: Line number on the supplying distribution order linked to this material line.

outputParameters.name: ATNR
outputParameters.description: Attribute number identifying any configured attribute connected to this material line.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Category indicating the type of reference order linked to this material line, such as customer or purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number linked to the manufacturing order for this material line.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order associated with this material line.

outputParameters.name: RORX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix used to distinguish sub-lines on the reference order line.

outputParameters.name: MALT
outputParameters.description: Code indicating that this line is an alternative material to another component.

outputParameters.name: FXCD
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of the manufacturing order quantity.

outputParameters.name: PREX
outputParameters.description: Priority used when selecting among alternative materials for this component.

outputParameters.name: WMST
outputParameters.description: Material status on the manufacturing order indicating allocation, picking, and issue progress.

outputParameters.name: DCCD
outputParameters.description: Number of decimal places used when processing quantities on this material line.

outputParameters.name: SPMT
outputParameters.description: Issue method defining when and how this component is issued to the manufacturing order.

outputParameters.name: PEUN
outputParameters.description: Product engineering unit of measure used to express the component quantity.

outputParameters.name: CRTM
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component is treated as critical material in availability and planning checks.

outputParameters.name: ISTO
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether this component is handled as intermediate stock during manufacturing order reporting.

outputParameters.name: ALON
outputParameters.description: Indicates whether the component's location is treated as an allocatable location when issuing via picking list.
